name: Kvant

seo.title: Kvant — AI product, SaaS and app development in Tashkent
seo.description: We design and build AI assistants, SaaS platforms and mobile apps. An IT Park resident: a team of 40 engineers, an MVP in 10–12 weeks.
seo.answer: Kvant is an IT company in Tashkent and an IT Park resident. We build LLM-based AI assistants, SaaS platforms and iOS and Android apps. An MVP launches in 10–12 weeks from $25,000; a dedicated team starts at $9,000 a month.

listing.description: A website for an IT company, AI product developer or SaaS. A glass sphere with rainbow dispersion, a wall of discipline words, a perspective case carousel — a tech image without the template feel.

sections.title: We build products that learn faster than the market
sections.subtitle: We design, build and scale digital products with AI inside — from a two-week prototype to a platform for a million users.

sections.label: Company
sections.title: We are an engineering team accountable for product results, not hours.
sections.text: 40 engineers, designers and analysts in Tashkent. We work in short two-week iterations and show a working build every Friday. The code, infrastructure and data are yours from day one: the repository lives in your account, and documentation is written along the way, not after.

sections.label: Expertise
sections.title: What we build
sections.intro: We take on the whole product or reinforce your team with individual engineers.

items.title: AI assistants and LLMs
items.text: Support and sales chatbots, document search (RAG), agents with access to your systems.

items.title: SaaS platforms
items.text: Multi-tenant web services: billing, roles, analytics, partner APIs.

items.title: Mobile apps
items.text: Native iOS and Android or Flutter: banking, delivery, booking services.

items.title: Dedicated team
items.text: Senior engineers for your stack, with a tech lead and weekly reporting.

items.title: Navo Assistant
items.text: An AI agent for a telecom operator’s call centre: it resolves 62% of requests without a human.

items.title: Sklad OS
items.text: A warehouse management platform for 120 distributors in the region.

items.title: Tez Pay
items.text: A wallet with P2P transfers and QR payments, 800,000 installs.

items.title: MedScan
items.text: X-ray image recognition as a second opinion for doctors.

items.title: Bozor Data
items.text: Demand forecasting for a retail chain of 300 stores.

items.title: Discovery
items.text: Two weeks: interviews, product map, architecture, an estimate in hours and money.

items.title: Prototype
items.text: A clickable prototype or a working AI demo on your data.

items.title: Development
items.text: Two-week sprints, a demo every Friday, CI/CD from day one.

items.title: Launch and growth
items.text: Release, monitoring, 24/7 support and metric-driven growth.

items.quote: In three months Kvant built an assistant that took more than half the routine off our operators. More importantly, they were honest about what AI should not do.
items.author: Timur Abdullaev

items.quote: We got a product team, not a contractor: they argued with us about metrics and turned out to be right.
items.author: Anna Kim

items.q: How much does an MVP cost?
items.a: An MVP of a web service or mobile app starts at $25,000; an AI assistant on your data starts at $15,000. We give an exact estimate after a two-week Discovery, which costs $3,000 and is credited to the project.

items.q: How quickly do you launch a product?
items.a: The average time to MVP is 10–12 weeks. We show a prototype or a working AI demo 2–3 weeks after kickoff.
You do. The repository and cloud infrastructure are created in your accounts, and rights are transferred by contract from the first commit.

items.q: Do you work with foreign companies?
items.a: Yes, a third of our clients are from Kazakhstan and Europe. As an IT Park resident we work under an export contract in dollars or euros.

items.q: Which AI models do you use?
items.a: We choose for the task and your data requirements: cloud LLMs from major providers, or open models deployed on your own server if data cannot leave it.
Support with up to a one-hour response on critical incidents and product development on a monthly plan — from $4,000 a month.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Tell us what we are building
sections.text: Send the idea in two paragraphs — within a day we will come back with questions and a first estimate.
